title: TCS NQT style · Advanced (Digital / Prime)
description: Advanced quant and reasoning, then advanced coding. 15 MCQs + 2 coding problems in 115 minutes. Original practice questions modelled on the publicly reported test pattern. Not an official or past paper.

questions.text: What is the volume of a cylinder with radius 7 cm and height 10 cm? (Use π = 22/7)
A starts a business with Rs 4000. After 4 months B joins with Rs 8000. At the end of the year the profit is Rs 3500. What is B's share?
What is the volume of a cylinder with radius 3.5 cm and height 20 cm? (Use π = 22/7)
What is the remainder when 2^26 is divided by 11?
The present ages of A and B are in the ratio 7:5. After 10 years, the ratio will be 73:55. What is A's present age?
questions.explanation: Let ages be 7x and 5x. (7x+10)/(5x+10) = 73/55 gives x = 9; A = 63.

questions.text: What is the volume of a cylinder with radius 14 cm and height 15 cm? (Use π = 22/7)
What is the sum of the first 14 terms of the series 9, 12, 15, ...?
The present ages of A and B are in the ratio 4:3. After 6 years, the ratio will be 26:21. What is A's present age?
questions.explanation: Let ages be 4x and 3x. (4x+6)/(3x+6) = 26/21 gives x = 5; A = 20.

questions.text: What comes next in the series: 16, 21, 27, 34, 42, ?
questions.explanation: Rule: differences increase by 1 (5, 6, 7, ...). Next term = 51.

questions.text: What comes next: CX, IR, OL, UF, ?
questions.explanation: First letters move +6; second letters move −6 from the other end of the alphabet.

questions.text: Asha is taller than Harsh. Sneha is taller than Zoya. Zoya is taller than Asha. Uma is taller than Isha. Harsh is taller than Uma. Who is the tallest?
questions.explanation: Chaining the clues: Sneha > Zoya > Asha > Harsh > Uma > Isha. The tallest is Sneha.

questions.text: Which number is the odd one out: 25, 84, 24, 60?
In a row of 23 students, Sneha is 10th from the left. Uma is 9 places to the right of Sneha. What is Uma's position from the right end?
questions.explanation: Uma is 19th from the left, so 23 − 19 + 1 = 5th from the right.

questions.text: In a row of 32 students, Esha is 16th from the left. Uma is 7 places to the right of Esha. What is Uma's position from the right end?
questions.explanation: Uma is 23rd from the left, so 32 − 23 + 1 = 10th from the right.

questions.title: Merge intervals
questions.text:
Given n closed intervals, merge all overlapping ones (touching intervals like [1,3] and [3,5] also merge). Print the number of merged intervals, then each merged interval as ‘start end’ in increasing order of start.

Input: first line n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5); then n lines ‘l r’ (0 ≤ l ≤ r ≤ 10^9).
Output: count, then one interval per line.

starterCode.python:
import sys

data = sys.stdin.read().split()
# write your code here
starterCode.javascript:
const data = require('fs').readFileSync(0, 'utf8').trim().split(/\s+/);
// write your code here

questions.explanation: Reference approach: see the standard technique for ‘Merge intervals’.

questions.title: Project selection (0/1 knapsack)
questions.text:
You have n projects; project i needs w[i] hours and earns v[i] points. With at most W hours, each project done at most once, print the maximum points.

Input: first line n and W (1 ≤ n ≤ 100, 1 ≤ W ≤ 10^4); then n lines ‘w v’ (1 ≤ w ≤ 10^4, 1 ≤ v ≤ 10^6).
Output: the maximum points.

data = sys.stdin.read().split()
# write your code here
